description.short: Access and speed up work across Atlassian apps
description.full: Rovo connects people, work and your organization's knowledge across Jira and Confluence. In Microsoft 365 Copilot, search Jira work items and Confluence pages, check sprint progress, create and update Jira work items, draft Confluence pages, and turn a sprint into a stakeholder-ready slide deck, without switching apps. An active Atlassian Cloud subscription with Rovo enabled may be required. Responses may include AI-generated content; verify important information. Learn more at https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo.
